rpc_microbenchmark.aggregation: median of the per-run percentiles; alternating before/after order
rpc_microbenchmark.scope: Local CPU-only IPC round trips; no claim of model throughput improvement.

kv_microbenchmark.geometry: Four all-layer pages per sample, two Qwen layouts, empty/90%/full quotas
kv_microbenchmark.timing: Opt-in client mutex wait and request/reply time. Owner RPC runs under page-management lock. This is not a multi-thread contention benchmark.
kv_microbenchmark.optimization: Keep synchronous release acknowledgement and immediate empty-chunk return; no speculative asynchronous release or retained empty-chunk cache.

scope_notes: CLI flags stay compatible; C++ callers must use BenchConfig.http/pd/ipc/kv/benchmark and PDExecutor for orchestration.
Each process shares a ZMQ context; socket ownership and no-replay-on-lost-reply behavior are unchanged. CUDA workers must still be exec-spawned.
Request state and KV failure handling are explicit. A failed release acknowledgement poisons the page group and prohibits subsequent local reuse.
